summary: MarketBeat overnight video from 2026-10-02 featuring guest Jonathan Rose of InvestorPlace, who shares four volatile names across cybersecurity, copper and uranium, favoring options with capped risk on pullbacks rather than outright share buying. RBRK — BUY (guest), Rubrik at a ~$115 reference price with January 2028 $145 call activity — his favourite cybersecurity play: already profitable, a ~$13B market-cap sweet spot, and non-discretionary AI-security spending for 5–10 years. FCX — BUY (guest), the large copper play still catching up after 2025 mine mudslides while copper takes out 10-year highs; a long-term buy-and-hold where he owns the stock. ERO — BUY (guest, expressed via options), a smaller copper name about one-tenth FCX's size, tightly correlated to cash copper — the guest prefers out-of-the-money calls over holding shares and steers long-term holders toward FCX. UROY — BUY (guest, reiterated), shared about a year earlier in the high $2s/low $3s — a uranium royalty model with long-term bullishness unchanged after the sector pullback. All first tracked calls, no flips.
